mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, description, group_code, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_permission WHERE code = #{code} LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.code, p.name, p.description, p.group_code, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_perm_group_item pgi ON pgi.permission_id = p.id INNER JOIN sys_perm_group pg ON pg.id = pgi.group_id INNER JOIN sys_role_perm_group rpg ON rpg.group_id = pg.id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rpg.role_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.code ASC

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.code, p.name, p.description, p.group_code, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_perm_group_item pgi ON pgi.permission_id = p.id INNER JOIN sys_perm_group pg ON pg.id = pgi.group_id INNER JOIN sys_role_perm_group rpg ON rpg.group_id = pg.id WHERE rpg.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY p.code ASC
